name: My True North
source:
A nonlinear visual novel about Personal Choice of a Human, Love, and the Journey to Yourself in a world of the living dead. Watch. Love. And don't go under the ice. Especially in the height of summer.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071300/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于人类的个人选择、爱情以及活死人世界中的自我之旅的非线性视觉小说。手表。爱。并且不要进入冰层下面。尤其是在盛夏。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071300/]Steam[/url]]
